moments.label: SABBATH NOON CLASS: History Repeats Itself - Message From Jeremiah

points: The foundation of the city is in the holy mountains, and the Lord loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob. This is about how the Most High hallowed Him a city, Jerusalem.

note.label: Psalm 87: Glorious Things Are Spoken of Zion

points: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. The Most High makes mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know Him, and of Philistia and Tyre with Ethiopia, saying this man was born there.

note.label: Psalm 87: Glorious Things Are Spoken of Zion

points: Of Zion it shall be said that this and that man was born in her, and the Most High Himself shall establish her. The Lord shall count, when He writeth up the people, that this man was born there.

note.label: Psalm 87: Glorious Things Are Spoken of Zion

points: As well the singers as the players of instruments shall be there; all the springs are in the Most High.

note.label: Psalm 87: Glorious Things Are Spoken of Zion

points: Reading the 1965 report on the Negro family, it says ‘individually Negro Americans reach the highest peaks of achievement’. That’s your Jesse Owens, all these different celebrities, LeBron James, Floyd Mayweather. Psalms 87 is the scripture that goes with that individual, and to get the full thought we jump to verse 1: “His foundation is in the holy mountains.”

“The Lord loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.” When you really go into that verse, the Most High is saying he loves Judah more than all other tribes. But the Most High loves Israel.

note.label: SABBATH NOON CLASS: History Repeats Itself - Message From Jeremiah

points: In Psalms 87 the sons of Korah are speaking about the other nations: they’ve got great men born out of other nations, great men come out of there. Now it gets to Israel: “And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.” Meaning in Israel, great people come out of here.

note.label: SABBATH NOON CLASS: History Repeats Itself - Message From Jeremiah

points: “The Lord shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there.” Who’s that? Jesus Christ.

note.label: SABBATH NOON CLASS: History Repeats Itself - Message From Jeremiah

points: “As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there”. Out of all the races, the best singers come out of blacks, Hispanics, Jamaicans, Native Americans. Think about it: the Harlem Renaissance, that was all Judah, that jazz music. God says when it comes to music, the best will come from my people.

“All my springs are in thee”: that’s the part we wanted. God says all my blessings are in thee. That’s why that report says individually Negro Americans reached the highest peaks of achievement: the blessing is in us. All we have to do is focus and tap into that nature and we will be great. Now us, repenting as Israelites, we want to be great for the Most High. But even some of our people that are not in the truth: Michael Jordan, there’s no basketball player like him, the blessing is in him. Barry Bonds, he’s Judah. Alex Rodriguez. All these individuals.

Those are just a few people compared to millions of us. The next sentence of the report says ‘but collectively’, among all the American ethnic and religious and regional groups, where some send their children to college and others pull them out of school at the eighth grade, ‘Negroes are among the weakest’. So this Edomite was saying when it comes to black people as a nation, they are at the bottom, but individually they are at the top.
